case_role: Real-field forecasting diagnostic and candidate-decision demonstration; not the definition of the academic problem.
response_normalization: Production change relative to the median of the latest four history weeks, scaled by that level plus 5000 m3.
prediction_support: Predictions are restricted to the 2.5th--97.5th percentile of production observed in the corresponding training period.
case_context_selection: The latest eligible decision window whose median field oil over the latest four history steps is at least 20000 m3.
decision_evidence: The field response model predicts changes from the latest production level for supported candidate schedules; no realized counterfactual field outcome is available for the alternative schedule.
